episodes.description: After a Marine Sergeant is found murdered in a National Park, Gibbs and the NCIS team partner with Mounted Police Sergeant May Dawson to solve a string of related crimes in the park.

episodes.title: Something Blue
episodes.description: The stress of McGee and Delilah's imminent wedding takes its toll, as Delilah is rushed to the hospital. Also, the NCIS team travels out to sea after a young and healthy Petty Officer aboard a Navy destroyer dies in his sleep.

episodes.title: Rendezvous
episodes.description: Gibbs, McGee and Torres travel to a remote area in Paraguay, controlled by a group of violent rebels, in an attempt to locate a missing Navy SEAL who disappeared during an unsanctioned trip.

episodes.title: House Divided
episodes.description: Two months after Gibbs and McGee were last seen fighting an elusive group of rebels in a Paraguay jungle, the NCIS team in D.C. tirelessly searches for their missing colleagues. Also, Vance and Torres are summoned to a congressional hearing regarding the fallout from the Paraguay mission.

episodes.title: Twofer
episodes.description: NCIS is called in to investigate when the body of a missing Navy Lieutenant who disappeared a year and a half ago is located by a cemetery grounds crew while they are relocating caskets on the property. Also, Gibbs and McGee must pass a psych evaluation with Doctor Grace Confalone before officially resuming all work responsibilities.

episodes.title: Exit Strategy
episodes.description: While on a stakeout with Metro P.D., Torres' partner mysteriously vanishes, with the subsequent investigation leading NCIS to uncover new evidence from a decade-old murder. Also, Ducky's friend, Cadence Darwin, presents him with a new opportunity during his guest lecture series.

episodes.title: Skeleton Crew
episodes.description: Director Vance welcomes NCIS Special Agent Jacqueline "Jack" Sloane, a forensic psychologist he lobbied to transfer from California, to headquarters. Also, in the midst of a storm that has shut down Washington, D.C. and knocked out power, the NCIS team investigates the kidnapping of a sailor, which sends Torres and Bishop out to sea to track evidence.

episodes.title: Fake It 'Til You Make It
episodes.description: After Reeves sees his friend get kidnapped, the NCIS team discovers the primary suspect disappeared two days ago with confidential military information. Also, an embarrassing photo from McGee's teenage years becomes a popular meme.

episodes.title: Trapped
episodes.description: After a petty officer is found murdered on a golf course, McGee spends hours on the victim's ham radio trying to locate a key witness. Also, Palmer asks his co-workers to donate to a charity that builds playgrounds for kids of all abilities, and Torres surprises them with his generosity.

episodes.title: Burden of Proof
episodes.description: After a convicted felon swears the NCIS agency framed him for murder a decade ago, Gibbs begins his own investigation, starting with a new autopsy by Ducky. Also, Senior FBI Agent Fornell joins the team, since he was the lead investigator in the original joint FBI and NCIS case.

episodes.title: Voices
episodes.description: An NCIS person of interest in a bribery and fraud case is found murdered after a runner is led to his body by a strange voice. Also, McGee and Delilah disagree on whether to find out the baby's sex or keep it a surprise.

episodes.title: Ready or Not
episodes.description: The team's Thanksgiving plans are put on hold while they track an elusive international arms dealer in D.C. who recently murdered an MI-5 officer who was Sloane's close friend. Also, Abby races Delilah to the hospital when her labor starts three weeks early.

episodes.title: Double Down
episodes.description: As Torres and Sloane run protection detail for U.S. Senator John Phillips in Afghanistan for the holidays, they must urgently return to the states after hearing the senator's son is in the ICU. Also, Gibbs and the team investigate the altercation that caused the life threatening injuries to the senator's son.

episodes.title: High Tide
episodes.description: Torres and Bishop go undercover as a criminal couple available for hire, during an NCIS sting operation tracking illegal drug-running out of the Norfolk civilian marina.

episodes.title: Dark Secrets
episodes.description: After a seemingly happy and successful Navy Lieutenant appears to have taken her own life, Gibbs and the team conduct a thorough investigation, interviewing family and friends from her past and present.

episodes.title: Family Ties
episodes.description: After McGee and Torres visit the home of a high schooler who witnessed a hit and run, her parents, Christopher and Julie Bell, flee with their daughter, leaving NCIS in the lurch. Also, Vance's daughter is arrested for shoplifting.

episodes.title: Keep Your Friends Close
episodes.description: After the body of a missing Navy commander is found, Vance orders Gibbs and the team to work with former FBI Agent Tobias "T.C." Fornell, the private investigator who was hired to locate him. Also, Bishop and Torres interview convicted investment advisor Albert Hathaway when the victim is linked to his highly publicized trial.

episodes.title: Keep Your Enemies Closer
episodes.description: NCIS strikes a deal with convicted murderer Paul Triff, giving him a 48-hour furlough at his former residence, now McGee's home, in exchange for information that can convict his former cellmate, Gabriel Hicks, the murderer who deceived Gibbs and Fornell.

episodes.title: Handle with Care
episodes.description: Gibbs and the team work to clear the name of retired Marine Sergeant John Ross when cyanide is found in one of the hundreds of care packages he sends to active-duty Marines.

episodes.title: One Man's Trash
episodes.description: Gibbs and Ducky are watching TV when they see the host handling a 200-year-old war stick that could be a match from a decade-old cold case.

episodes.title: Death from Above
episodes.description: The NCIS headquarters are evacuated after the team discovers a body as well as bomb materials on the roof of the squad room. Also, the team reads the first draft of Ducky's book.

episodes.title: The Numerical Limit
episodes.description: Gibbs is granted protective custody of a 10-year-old orphaned refugee, Elena, when an NCIS case reveals she is the target of a violent gang.

episodes.title: Sight Unseen
episodes.description: NCIS searches for a petty officer suspected of assault who escapes when the sheriff transporting him crashes into a lake. Also, Torres works closely with Annie Barth, a key blind witness who heard vital evidence needed to solve the case.

episodes.title: One Step Forward
episodes.description: Sara Carter begs Gibbs to investigate her mother's murder as she believes the local authorities convicted the wrong man. Also, Abby is awarded a dinner reservation for two to a brand-new five-star restaurant in an igloo and has to decide which coworker deserves to go with her.

episodes.title: Two Steps Back
episodes.description: When evidence reveals an NCIS team member is a hitman's latest target, the team must search through old case files to determine who is seeking vengeance.

episodes.title: Fallout
episodes.description: While Gibbs attends the memorial service for a friend who was lost at sea, he discovers that the deceased, Navy Captain Phillip Brooks, has been hiding in a fallout shelter after his boat was attacked and he swam to shore.

episodes.title: Date with Destiny
episodes.description: Sloane is adamant that a man who held her hostage and tortured her years ago in Afghanistan, and was believed to have been killed following her rescue, is alive and in D.C., leading Vance and Gibbs to fear she is willing to risk everything to destroy this man.

episodes.title: Destiny's Child
episodes.description: One month after Director Vance was kidnapped, Gibbs is assigned the role of acting director in his absence while the team searches worldwide for his whereabouts.

episodes.title: Love Thy Neighbor
episodes.description: After a Navy lieutenant is found murdered in his hot tub, the team interviews several families in the victim's peculiar neighborhood. Also, Torres must face the consequences after a volatile night out with Palmer.

episodes.title: Boom
episodes.description: One of the NCIS agents is starstruck after the team investigates an explosion outside the home of Navy Petty Officer First Class Todd Nicholas and his wife, popular reality TV star Sheba Nicholas. Also, Vance continues physical therapy for the injuries sustained when he was held hostage.

episodes.title: Third Wheel
episodes.description: Gibbs' quiet vacation at his remote cabin is interrupted by a surprise visit from Tobias Fornell and Navy Captain Phillip Brooks, as well as a call from NCIS asking for his help locating a robber hiding in the woods near him.

episodes.title: Fragments
episodes.description: After a 50-year-old tape recording left by a murder victim is found, the NCIS team tries to exonerate Ray Jennings, the Marine serving a life sentence for the crime.

episodes.title: Beneath the Surface
episodes.description: After NCIS arrives at a Halloween crime scene, Torres recognizes the victim as a friend from federal law enforcement training. Also, Jimmy thinks his lab is haunted by ghosts after objects keep mysteriously moving.

episodes.title: A Thousand Words
episodes.description: After a mural by a street artist and activist is stolen, the NCIS investigation leads to a conspiracy regarding a Navy contractor and the safety of ocean mammals. Also, Bishop shares a special connection with the street artist.

episodes.title: Friendly Fire
episodes.description: McGee and Bishop travel to Afghanistan after a murder case in the states is linked to a string of soldiers killed by friendly fire overseas. Also, Kasie leaves the lab and accompanies Torres into the field to process additional forensic evidence.

episodes.title: Tailing Angie
episodes.description: When the lead suspect of an unsolved and high-profile robbery case is released from prison, the NCIS team resumes their investigation with an undercover stakeout.

episodes.title: What Child Is This?
episodes.description: The team's holiday plans are put on hold when the murder investigation of a Navy veteran includes the discovery of a newborn baby who has no identification and no apparent ties to a family.

episodes.title: Toil and Trouble
episodes.description: United States Secretary of Defense Wynn Crawford shuts down Gibbs' murder investigation and demands that Special Agents McGee and Torres be arrested for their actions in the case.

episodes.title: The Last Link
episodes.description: An old family friend, Army Corporal John Sydney, beseeches Gibbs to join him on a road trip to search for a missing military I.D. bracelet. Also, a Navy Lieutenant in NCIS protective custody is poisoned by an infamous drug dealer.

episodes.title: She
episodes.description: After a malnourished and confused 9-year-old is found hiding in a storage unit, NCIS reopens an old missing persons case when the girl is believed to be the daughter of a Navy recruit who disappeared 10 years ago. Also, Bishop discovers notes that Special Agent Ziva David kept on the case long after NCIS officially stopped investigating.

episodes.title: Once Upon a Tim
episodes.description: McGee reluctantly visits his high school after the unique computer password he used as a teenager is linked to the murder of a department of defense contractor. The case escalates when an intruder breaks into McGee's home in an attempt to steal his archaic high school computer.

episodes.title: Crossing the Line
episodes.description: The NCIS team investigates a man overboard fatality from a Navy destroyer at sea. Also, Torres is frustrated with Vance's assignment to mentor three high school students.

episodes.title: Bears and Cubs
episodes.description: Jimmy is torn between family and work after his father-in-law, Ed, asks him to tamper with evidence from NCIS' current murder investigation. Also, Ed's poker buddy, Anthony DiNozzo, Sr., offers to help with the case.

episodes.title: Silent Service
episodes.description: Director Vance is notified by the Pentagon that the nuclear submarine Gibbs and Bishop are aboard to conduct a murder investigation has gone radio silent.

episodes.title: Mona Lisa
episodes.description: Torres relies on his team's investigative skills after he wakes up on a dilapidated fishing boat, covered in blood and unable to remember the last 12 hours.

episodes.title: Perennial
episodes.description: Following an active shooter lockdown at a naval hospital, the NCIS team searches for a suspect who fled the scene. Also, someone from Sloane's past was inside the hospital and is a key witness in the case.

episodes.title: Hail & Farewell
episodes.description: NCIS investigates the murder of a Marine Major believed to have been killed in the 9/11 attack on the Pentagon after human remains are discovered at a construction site. A personal history with the victim drives Gibbs to solve her crime.

episodes.title: Judge, Jury…
episodes.description: After entering cold case DNA into the system, Kasie solves a 30-year-old murder case, but a loophole in the legal system may set the suspect free. Also, McGee visits an elite technology company in Silicon Valley that is offering him a highly paid position.

episodes.title: ...and Executioner
episodes.description: After NCIS finds a secret government bank account that's funding a nationwide network of vigilante justice, the team must determine who is acting as judge and jury.

episodes.title: Lost Time
episodes.description: The NCIS team investigates the murder of a Marine Sergeant in the States who was hailed as a war hero for his efforts overseas. Also, Gibbs turns to Doctor Grace Confalone for advice after he uncharacteristically unravels and abandons his team at a crime scene investigation.

episodes.title: Daughters
episodes.description: Former FBI Agent Tobias Fornell pleads with Gibbs to do whatever is necessary to take down drug dealers and suppliers in the area after his daughter, Emily Fornell, is hospitalized from an opiate overdose. Gibbs is haunted by the personal aspects of the case and his history with vigilante justice.

episodes.title: Out of the Darkness
episodes.description: Ziva surprises Gibbs with a cryptic warning, prompting him to question why she remained underground for years while being presumed dead by family and friends, and what led to her return.

episodes.title: Into the Light
episodes.description: With their lives in danger, Gibbs and Ziva's rogue investigation takes an unexpected turn when a possible terrorist plot is revealed.

episodes.title: Going Mobile
episodes.description: After the body of a Marine Lieutenant is found hidden under an 18-wheeler, the NCIS team tracks the vehicle's previous locations to pinpoint the crime scene and suspect. Also, Sloane encourages the team to sit down and talk about Ziva's recent reappearance.

episodes.title: Someone Else's Shoes
episodes.description: The NCIS team links a bizarre crime scene at Arlington National Cemetery to a string of attacks on homeless veterans. Also, Vance orders McGee, Bishop and Torres to complete hours of evidence garage cleanup duty for withholding information.

episodes.title: Wide Awake
episodes.description: NCIS investigates Marine Corporal Laney Alimonte after evidence suggests she murdered her neighbor while being treated for insomnia by a hypnotherapist. Also, Gibbs befriends his new neighbors after the 9-year-old's baseball crashes through his window.

episodes.title: Institutionalized
episodes.description: After a petty officer's son is found murdered at his "welcome home from prison" party, evidence suggests Kasie's lifelong best friend, Dante Brown, is the suspect.

episodes.title: No Vacancy
episodes.description: While investigating a Marine's murder, the NCIS team uncovers a labyrinth of live-streaming spy cameras hidden in the rooms of a Virginia motel.

episodes.title: Musical Chairs
episodes.description: The NCIS team investigates the murder of a musician in the Navy's most elite band that performs at diplomatic events around the world.

episodes.title: IRL
episodes.description: The NCIS team investigates a petty officer's murder that was live-streamed on a popular gaming app. Also, Gibbs watches his 11-year-old neighbor, Phineas, when his mom must leave on a last-minute trip.

episodes.title: The North Pole
episodes.description: Gibbs and the team assist Ziva with “the one thing” she said she would need to take care of before returning to see her family.

episodes.title: In the Wind
episodes.description: Gibbs must face the reality of his actions after he assists Ziva with "the one thing" she said she would need to take care of before returning to her family.

episodes.title: Flight Plan
episodes.description: The NCIS team investigates an F-18 crash and the subsequent disappearance of the pilot who operated the aircraft. Also, McGee reluctantly discusses a very personal decision with his teammates.

episodes.title: Sound Off
episodes.description: After a body is found at an unmanned aerial vehicle testing site, the NCIS team must determine if the death was murder or an accident. Also, Palmer carefully interviews medical examiner assistant candidates.

episodes.title: On Fire
episodes.description: After Torres and Bishop are victims of a hit-and-run, Torres fights for his life in the ICU.

episodes.title: Lonely Hearts
episodes.description: The lead suspect in an NCIS murder investigation is a woman Gibbs' friend, Phillip Brooks, met on a dating site. Also, Sloane has a secret admirer on Valentine's Day.

episodes.title: Ephemera
episodes.description: While investigating the suicide of a retired Navy officer who left a rare, valuable – and possibly stolen – coin to the National Museum of the Navy, the team imagines themselves in his life story in order to piece together how the coin ended up in his possession.

episodes.title: In a Nutshell
episodes.description: As the NCIS team investigates the death of a Navy officer murdered the same way as his parents a decade ago, they stumble across a storage container filled with dollhouses that display recreations of murder scenes. Also, the team agrees to clean out their living spaces, but some have a harder time saying goodbye to their possessions than others.

episodes.title: Schooled
episodes.description: The team searches for answers when the body of a well-regarded Navy technician in the Reserves is found floating in a lake where a popular community event is being held. Also, Sloane is caught off-guard when her daughter, Faith, makes an unexpected request.

episodes.title: Blarney
episodes.description: When Kasie and Jimmy are held hostage in a diner after a jewelry store robbery goes awry, they attempt to keep the other customers safe from the thieves.

episodes.title: The Arizona
episodes.description: The team tries to verify the identity of Joe Smith, who claims he served on the U.S.S. Arizona during the attack on Pearl Harbor, and wants to be buried there upon his death.

episodes.title: Sturgeon Season
episodes.description: Gibbs and Fornell attempt to track down the leader of a drug ring who supplied drugs to Fornell's daughter. Also, the team deals with the case of a missing cadaver from the NCIS autopsy room.

episodes.title: Everything Starts Somewhere
episodes.description: Flashbacks reveal the murder case that first introduced young Gibbs to NCIS and his introduction to young, new-to-America Ducky.

episodes.title: Blood and Treasure
episodes.description: The discovery of two dead bodies in a forest leads the NCIS team into the wild world of modern-day treasure hunting. Also, Gibbs and Fornell get deeper into their search for the opioid kingpin.

episodes.title: Sunburn
episodes.description: McGee and his wife Delilah's (Margo Harshman) Bahamian vacation turns into a high-stakes mission when a case NCIS is tracking of a dead escape room manager has ties to the island. Also, Gibbs fears the worst when his search for Fornell leads to blood.

episodes.title: Head of the Snake
episodes.description: Gibbs and Fornell's crusade to find the head of the drug ring responsible for Fornell's daughter Emily's overdose comes to a climax. Also, Gibbs and Vance finally let the team in on a case that has dangerous implications.

episodes.title: 1mm
episodes.description: Following a tip about smuggled weapons, Bishop and Torres engage in a shootout in a former sheriff's residence that's now a historical site, only to find themselves locked in abandoned jail cells there.

episodes.title: The First Day
episodes.description: NCIS investigates the murder of a Navy officer who was killed while driving home a recently released inmate. Also, Gibbs helps Palmer deal with a personal trauma.

episodes.title: True Believer
episodes.description: When Sloane's name is discovered in Afghanistan at the site of an abandoned bus with a dead driver, Gibbs accompanies her on a trip to find a group of girls who were kidnapped from the bus. Also, McGee, Bishop and Torres track down a hacker who emailed compromising information to the Taliban.

episodes.title: Winter Chill
episodes.description: NCIS dives into the competitive world of food trucks after finding a man frozen to death in the back of one.

episodes.title: Watchdog
episodes.description: NCIS uncovers a secret dogfighting ring, which leads to an unexpected move by one of the team members.

episodes.title: Gut Punch
episodes.description: Vance assigns McGee, Torres and Bishop to COVID compliance duty at a foreign affairs summit, where they discover a link to another NCIS team's murder case.

episodes.title: Sangre
episodes.description: Evidence from the stabbing of a Marine Sergeant leads Torres to meet his father, Miguel, who left when he was a child.

episodes.title: Misconduct
episodes.description: While the team investigates a biker killed in a hit and run, Gibbs prepares to testify against a financial advisor who stole millions from his Navy clients.

episodes.title: Unseen Improvements
episodes.description: NCIS tracks a stolen laptop to the uncle of a young boy, Phineas, Gibbs' former neighbor.

episodes.title: Blown Away
episodes.description: When members of an NCIS Regional Enforcement Action Capabilities Training Team (REACT) are killed during an explosion, NCIS Special Agent Jessica Knight, the lone surviving member, helps crack the case using high tech body armor.

episodes.title: Rule 91
episodes.description: While pursuing a dangerous arms dealer, the team is shocked when Bishop is implicated in an old NSA leak. Also, Gibbs and Marcie realize the killer they've been tracking may be onto them.

episodes.title: Blood in the Water
episodes.description: As the NCIS team searches for Gibbs after wreckage from his boat is discovered, they find out he was tracking a serial killer with journalist Marcie Warren, who wrote an exposé on him.

episodes.title: Nearly Departed
episodes.description: While trying to find the serial killer Gibbs was after, the NCIS team discovers another person has been tracking the case as well.

episodes.title: Road to Nowhere
episodes.description: Gibbs and Parker go on a road trip to find one of the serial killer's victims. Also, Agent Knight goes undercover at a large manufacturing company with ties to the murders.

episodes.title: Great Wide Open
episodes.description: Gibbs and McGee head to Alaska while the team works at home to uncover the conspiracy behind the serial killer.

episodes.title: Face the Strange
episodes.description: The NCIS team investigates the death of a Navy commander whose body suddenly explodes before Jimmy can examine it.

episodes.title: False Start
episodes.description: NCIS investigates the death of a beloved Navy commander who trained some of the top athletes in the country.

episodes.title: Docked
episodes.description: NCIS investigates the death of a man on a cruise ship whose body is discovered in the ship's sauna by none other than McGee's mother-in-law, Judy.

episodes.title: Peacekeeper
episodes.description: NCIS investigates the case of a Navy reservist whose body is found in a beat-up car at the end of a gun range. Also, Kasie weighs the pros and cons of buying a gun.

episodes.title: Collective Memory
episodes.description: When a hotshot financial advisor is found shot at a naval station, NCIS investigates the case by interviewing the victim's three-dimensional hologram of herself, which she created before her death.

episodes.title: Pledge of Allegiance
episodes.description: NCIS is called in when Navy Chief Warrant Officer Rafi Nazar is suspected of trying to sell stolen classified Navy software used to pilot combat drones.

episodes.title: All Hands
episodes.description: After a civilian research vessel in the North Atlantic picks up a small boat of wounded Navy officers, NCIS arrives on the ship and is forced to hide after discovering terrorists on board. Also, Agent Knight takes a paper doll with her on the mission to capture photos for her niece's grade school class.

episodes.title: Fight or Flight
episodes.description: When the body of a Navy lieutenant is discovered missing an eye, the NCIS investigation leads to the world of cage fighting.

episodes.title: The Helpers
episodes.description: While investigating the death of an intruder at Quantico, Jimmy and Kasie are exposed to a deadly biotoxin, and the NCIS team calls on Doctor Carol Wilson for help as they race to find the antidote. Also, Torres tries to distract Jimmy's daughter, who came to the office to spend the day with her dad.

episodes.title: First Steps
episodes.description: As NCIS investigates the cause of death of a reservist Navy Seal surgeon, they're forced to bring Vance's daughter, Kayla, who recently trained with NCIS, to help with a highly dangerous mission.

episodes.title: Thick as Thieves
episodes.description: Parker's delinquent past resurfaces when NCIS is called to Philadelphia to investigate the death of a Navy petty officer.

episodes.title: The Wake
episodes.description: A gruesome mishap at a Navy petty officer's gender-reveal party leads NCIS to the case of a missing teacher that was popularized on a true crime podcast.

episodes.title: Starting Over
episodes.description:
NCIS investigates the apparent suicide of a retired Navy officer who was in Palmer and Knight’s grief group. Also, Torres gets a call from NCIS Special Agent Jane Tennant to come to Hawai’i when she gets a lead on a witness from a case they worked on together.

The crossover continues on NCIS Hawai'i S01E18.

episodes.title: Last Dance
episodes.description: When an infamous arms dealer, Reymundo Diaz, is released from prison and bodies start piling up, Torres is forced to face the repercussions of his actions during an undercover operation he worked on years ago.

episodes.title: The Brat Pack
episodes.description: NCIS investigates a ring of clever teenage partygoers when a string of break-ins takes place at Marine Base Quantico. While working the case, Special Agent McGee forms a bond with one of the teens, Teagan Fields.

episodes.title: All or Nothing
episodes.description: NCIS investigates the unexpected death of a Navy reservist who was an investigative journalist. Also, Knight and Jimmy's budding romance is put on hold when a vital organ transfer goes fatally wrong.

episodes.title: Birds of a Feather
episodes.description: When Agent Parker is framed for murder, the team puts their jobs and lives on the line to buy time and uncover the truth.

episodes.title: A Family Matter
episodes.description: Special Agent Alden Parker is still on the run with his ex-wife Vivian, so the team investigates who from his past might have a personal vendetta against him in hopes of clearing Parker's name. Enlisting the help of NCIS: Hawai'i's Special Agent Jane Tennant and Computer Specialist Ernie Malick, who are in town meeting with Director Leon Vance in preparation for a global military exercise, the group tracks down their prime suspect, The Raven.

episodes.title: Daddy Issues
episodes.description: McGee's personal life and professional life intersect when a dad from his children's school is linked to a break-in at a government storage bunker.

episodes.title: Unearth
episodes.description: When a dead body is found at an ancient burial site that is thought to be cursed, the team tries to determine the motive and the symbolism behind the crime. Also, as Torres continues therapy with Dr. Grace, he discovers that their lives are in danger.

episodes.title: Leave No Trace
episodes.description: Agent Knight's past resurfaces when her ex-boyfriend, a National Parks Service agent, teams up with NCIS to investigate a campsite murder.

episodes.title: Guardian
episodes.description: Agent Parker steps up to protect Director Vance after a terrifying home invasion. Also, the team detects advancements in Jessica and Jimmy's blossoming romance.

episodes.title: The Good Fighter
episodes.description: When an NCIS agent turns up dead and Kasie goes unaccounted for, the team must work quickly to find the killer.

episodes.title: Love Lost
episodes.description: NCIS must investigate the Secretary of the Navy when her husband claims she tried to murder him.

episodes.title: Turkey Trot
episodes.description: After an unknown shooter causes chaos at an annual Thanksgiving 5K, time is of the essence for the NCIS team to find the culprit. Also, Kasie joins Knight for Thanksgiving lunch at Knight's sister's house.

episodes.title: Higher Education
episodes.description: NCIS investigates the death of a college student who was killed while running across the street and had connections to McGee's wife, Delilah.

episodes.title: Too Many Cooks
episodes.description:
NCIS agents from Washington, D.C., Los Angeles and Hawai’i, all in D.C. to attend the retirement party of a beloved Federal Law Enforcement Training Center (FLETC) professor, find themselves jointly investigating his shocking suicide.

The crossover continues on NCIS Hawai'i S02E10 and NCIS Los Angeles S14E10.

episodes.title: Bridges
episodes.description: Parker discovers he's a victim of identity theft while investigating the unusual murder of a Navy ensign. Also, Knight and Jimmy face hurdles in their relationship as their connection heightens.

episodes.title: Big Rig
episodes.description: When an old pal of Torres' comes to him – disheveled and bloodied – for guidance amidst an undercover FBI operation and then disappears, NCIS helps track him down. Also, McGee prepares to be a contestant on a popular game show.

episodes.title: Evil Eye
episodes.description: In preparation for a role, a world-renowned actress shadows the NCIS team as they investigate a decapitation case.

episodes.title: Old Wounds
episodes.description: Parker grapples with his emotions when a conman from his past turns up as a prime suspect in the murder of a navy officer transporting millions of dollars' worth of opioids.

episodes.title: Unusual Suspects
episodes.description: NCIS investigates the death of a ride-share driver who was found after a car accident. Also, Parker's dad, who is temporarily living with him, assists the team in their investigation.

episodes.title: Butterfly Effect
episodes.description: The NCIS team jumps into motion to investigate who is responsible for a potential bio terror attack at a strip mall parking garage. Also, Knight's father deals with a health scare while in Japan.

episodes.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
episodes.description: NCIS works to solve the murder of a Marine private who appears to have been killed for helping an Afghan refugee. Also, Jimmy navigates the pressure of parenting his teenage daughter, who is eager to go out on an unchaperoned group date.

episodes.title: Head Games
episodes.description: The NCIS team digs deep to investigate a Navy lieutenant who's accused of trying to murder her husband but has no memory of the attack. Also, Kasie navigates a potential medical scare.

episodes.title: In the Spotlight
episodes.description: Agent Knight goes viral for saving a mother and child from a potentially fatal car accident.

episodes.title: Second Opinion
episodes.description: NCIS works to solve the murder of a senator's daughter who has a rebellious reputation and large online following. Also, Jimmy gets competitive with an old college rival.

episodes.title: Kompromat
episodes.description: When a suspicious murder occurs in the classified section of the National Archive, NCIS must investigate a string of Russian spy encounters that may be linked to the crime. Also, Jimmy accidentally makes a confession that could change the course of his relationship with Knight.

episodes.title: Black Sky
episodes.description: Agent Torres finds himself in prison as the team tries to stop an impending terror attack on U.S. soil.

episodes.title: Algún Día
episodes.description: The NCIS team must help Torres when he puts his future at stake by confronting the man who tormented his family when he was a child.

episodes.title: The Stories We Leave Behind
episodes.description: As NCIS mourns the loss of Ducky, the agents find comfort in working on one of his unfinished cases involving a woman whose father was dishonorably discharged from the Marines.

episodes.title: Lifeline
episodes.description: When the NCIS team engages in Walk-a-Mile day to gain a new perspectives on different departments, things take a turn when Kasie receives a distress call from a mysterious man.

episodes.title: Left Unsaid
episodes.description: The NCIS team is in a race against time to find a missing officer who disappeared during his wedding proposal.

episodes.title: The Plan
episodes.description: With the help of Knight's dad, Special Agent in Charge Feng Zhao, NCIS works to unravel the mystery of a recently used service weapon belonging to a missing agent. Also, McGee is in a tailspin when DNA results reveal a close relative he was unaware of.

episodes.title: Strange Invaders
episodes.description: After discovering a navy pilot's body riddled with unusual wounds, NCIS' investigation draws the team into the rabbit hole of UFO conspiracy theories.

episodes.title: A Thousand Yards
episodes.description: NCIS comes under attack by a mysterious enemy from the past. Also, Vance tries to mend fences with his estranged son by explaining why, despite the ongoing dangers of his job, he still chooses to stay at NCIS.

episodes.title: Heartless
episodes.description: The NCIS team looks for a motive behind the kidnapping and death of a famous heart surgeon.

episodes.title: Prime Cut
episodes.description: After discovering the remains of a Marine captain, the NCIS team travels to Texas to interrogate the suspected killer.

episodes.title: Reef Madness
episodes.description: Parker and Knight discover three bodies on an old Navy ship that's about to be sunk and turned into an artificial reef, when they're suddenly locked inside by a mysterious figure. Also, Vance offers Knight a unique opportunity.

episodes.title: Empty Nest
episodes.description: NCIS searches for a missing undercover agent in the midst of an active hostage situation.

episodes.title: Foreign Bodies
episodes.description: As Vance prepares to host diplomatic talks with Venezuela, the team is called in to investigate the dead body of one of his inside men.

episodes.title: The Trouble with Hal
episodes.description: NCIS is called in to investigate when a lieutenant returns home on the eve of Halloween to find a surprise party being thrown for someone else at his place.

episodes.title: Sticks & Stones
episodes.description: After receiving intelligence on deadly threats to multiple locations that could lead to a catastrophic war, NCIS is called in to try to neutralize the danger.

episodes.title: In from the Cold
episodes.description: NCIS works with the CIA to discover what secrets are being kept by Captain Butler, an elderly former spy with dementia.

episodes.title: Knight and Day
episodes.description: Things become tense when Knight is assigned to protect his wife after the home of a high-level defense contractor is attacked.

episodes.title: Hardboiled
episodes.description: Torres receives intel from a confidential informant regarding top secret naval information that's at risk of being sold.

episodes.title: Out of Control
episodes.description: NCIS investigates a murder related to a car that begins driving on its own. Also, Parker is still seeing visions of Lily.

episodes.title: Humbug
episodes.description: When a shocking tell-all threatens to ruin Christmas for a decorated Marine, NCIS must unwrap the truth and deliver a holiday miracle — before the book hits shelves and turns a hero's legacy into a holiday disaster.

episodes.title: Baker's Man
episodes.description: After NCIS learns that the owner of Parker’s favorite bakery is being blackmailed, they hatch a plan to save her from the perpetrators. Also, tensions heighten when Torres’ secret romance is discovered.

episodes.title: For Better or Worse
episodes.description: NCIS stages a fake wedding for two of its own in an attempt to take down the mob.

episodes.title: Fun and Games
episodes.description: NCIS investigates the fatal poisoning of one of Kasie's forensic scientists. Meanwhile, McGee is questioned by the Pentagon regarding the contents of his book.

episodes.title: Bad Blood
episodes.description: NCIS investigates the case of a Navy lieutenant found dead at a blood donation bank. Meanwhile, McGee needs help from the team to raise money for his twins’ school fundraiser.

episodes.title: Close to Home
episodes.description: When Torres receives a text from Jimmy's daughter who has discovered a large sum of money near the naval library, the team works together to investigate.

episodes.title: Moonlit
episodes.description: After a Navy Lieutenant's death reveals ties to Special Agent Sawyer, Torres and Knight uncover a murder linked to a wealthy family. Meanwhile, Parker discovers a shocking connection between his mother's death and Lily.

episodes.title: Ladies' Night
episodes.description: A girls' night out takes an unexpected turn when NCIS is called to investigate the motive of a possible arsonist. Also, Torres struggles to find work/life balance.

episodes.title: Killer Instinct
episodes.description: After NCIS captures the hitman known as "The Poet," the team races to uncover who ordered the assassination of a Navy chief.

episodes.title: After the Storm
episodes.description: When a trio of combat vets are found murdered in a D.C. motel room, NCIS tracks down a suspect who refuses to talk to anyone but Sam Hanna.

episodes.title: Irreconcilable Differences
episodes.description: McGee's career and credibility are on the line when he investigates the deputy director for corruption. Also, Torres and Knight receive some surprising news.

episodes.title: Nexus
episodes.description: As NCIS investigates a dangerous connection between the Nexus cartel and Parker's longtime nemesis, mob boss Carla Marino, the team uncovers a high-stakes plot involving stolen nuclear material. With time running out, Parker is forced into an uneasy alliance that could determine the fate of the operation - and his own future.

episodes.title: Prodigal Son (Part I)
episodes.description: Reeling from his father's murder, Parker goes to extreme lengths to hunt down the woman he holds responsible, mob boss Carla Marino, jeopardizing not only his own future but the team's.

episodes.title: Prodigal Son (Part II)
episodes.description: Parker’s pursuit of vengeance for his father’s murder could have deadly consequences, while his sister, Navy vice admiral Harriet Parker, faces an impossible choice in pursuit of power.

episodes.title: The Sound and the Fury
episodes.description: When a petty officer's death is connected to a blackmail investigation, the team is forced to work with Special Agent Sawyer on the case, which takes a terrifying turn for Torres. Meanwhile, Knight is offered an opportunity to train with NCIS Elite.

episodes.title: Gone Girls
episodes.description: The team investigates a U.S. marine who is believed to have kidnapped the wife of one of the most powerful men at the Department of Justice.

episodes.title: Now and Then
episodes.description: A prison break by an inmate who had just three weeks left on a sentence compels the team to reopen the case of a naval officer’s death that was originally investigated by Gibbs and Franks in the ‘90s, and enlist the help of retired special agent Vera Strickland. Also, the team has different views on what to include in a special Navy time capsule. Crossover with NCIS: Origins 02x05

episodes.title: Page-Turner
episodes.description: When McGee is kidnapped while promoting his latest book in the Deep Six crime series, the team investigates his self-professed "#1 fan" - and a potential link to a murder case involving stolen classified documents.

episodes.title: God Only Knows
episodes.description: A kidnapped teen leads the team to a Navy SEAL who survived captivity by the Taliban but may have committed murder after returning home. Also, Jimmy finally shares his findings about the mysterious death of Parker's mother with his boss.

episodes.title: Stolen Moments
episodes.description: When a man is shot by the Secret Service outside the vice president's official residence, NCIS is aided in the case by a new member of the team: an AI chatbot being beta-tested by the Department of Justice.

episodes.title: Heaven and Nature
episodes.description: McGee and Torres try to recover a stolen truck filled with toys for the Navy’s annual Christmas drive while the truth about Parker’s mother is finally revealed. Also, Knight is given her first NCIS: Elite mission, which involves tracking down a former member of the team.

episodes.title: Her
episodes.description: On her first NCIS: Elite mission, Knight is given orders to hunt down and arrest Eleanor Bishop after the former member of the NCIS team is designated a wanted cyber-terrorist. In need of someone to trust, Bishop turns to Torres, and the two come face to face for the first time since she abruptly left nearly five years ago.

episodes.title: Army of One
episodes.description: When a desperate man barricades himself inside an ammo warehouse, Knight is the only negotiator he'll talk to, claiming she once saved him before. As explosives tick and trust frays, Knight clashes with the CID officer running the standoff, each convinced theirs is the only way out.

episodes.title: In Too Deep
episodes.description: A murdered drone pilot leads the team to a missing woman from McGee's past and a relationship he thought was long behind him. But as the case deepens, McGee realizes her reappearance could unravel more than an investigation, it could change the course of his life.

episodes.title: All Good Things
episodes.description: When the son of a Marine that Gibbs once helped comes to NCIS in desperation, the fractured team reunites off the books. But chasing justice without a badge may cost them more than their careers.

episodes.title: Fleeting
episodes.description: Navy Week turns electric when a stolen squad car flips and reveals a sailor stabbed in the trunk. As D.C. spirals into chaos, the team chases a killer while carrying the weight of recent events.

episodes.title: Knick-Knack
episodes.description: A murder aboard a museum ship becomes a cryptic treasure hunt when a dying Navy captain leaves a final clue. To solve it, the team must decode what was worth killing - and dying - for.

episodes.title: S.O.S.
episodes.description: A Navy lieutenant resurfaces six months after her plane vanished with a story that doesn't quite add up. As the team peels back the mystery of a crash that was anything but accidental, every answer sparks a new twist.

episodes.title: Reboot
episodes.description: With most of NCIS away and the mainframe shut down for a midnight upgrade, Kasie and a skeleton crew are left in a darkened building when someone begins hunting from inside. What starts as a routine reboot becomes a high-stakes game of cat and mouse through powerless hallways until an unexpected ally, Sam Hanna, steps into the fight.

episodes.title: Bad Impressions
episodes.description: The team races to help one of their own who has been framed for murder and caught in a widening conspiracy that could compromise national security.

episodes.title: Deal with the Devil
episodes.description: As a secret immunity deal threatens to let a man walk free, Parker fights to keep the case alive. But when his estranged sister suddenly appears - and buried family wounds resurface - the battle for justice becomes deeply personal.

episodes.title: Sons and Daughters
episodes.description: One year after a deadly coffee shop bombing, a new explosion proves the attack wasn't the work of a lone wolf - a case that forces the team to confront legacy and loyalty.

episodes.title: Wayward Son
episodes.description: While dealing with the fallout from the shooting involving McGee's son, the team investigates a mysterious new threat to the Secretary of the Navy and receives help from an unexpected source: Tony DiNozzo, newly arrived in D.C. to open a satellite office of his private security firm.

episodes.title: Clean Slate
episodes.description: When a man is murdered after a neighborhood dinner party, the team discovers every guest is lying - about the strange break-in at the victim's house, what they were burning in their backyards and who they really are. And the deeper the team digs, the less they can agree on what kind of case they're even working.

episodes.title: Sleeping Dogs
episodes.description: When Torres' retired undercover identity is used to commit a string of murders, he's forced to team up with his grizzled old-school former handler, Walt Keller, and confront a darker version of himself that he thought he'd left behind.

episodes.title: Like and Subscribe
episodes.description: When a sailor moonlighting as a contestant on an online game show turns up murdered, the team discovers his death has nothing to do with the show's prize money. Also, Tony faces a threat far more intimidating than any killer.

episodes.title: Speechless
episodes.description: When the team finds an 8-year-old girl, Chloe, hiding alone in her apartment and her Marine mother missing, they discover the shy witness is hiding a surprising skill that just might crack the case wide open. As the investigation unfolds, it's a race against time that tests just how far a parent will go to protect family.

episodes.title: Ride or Die
episodes.description: When Torres gets roped into driving a getaway car during a kidnapping, he goes undercover to protect the target - staying one wrong move away from getting himself, and everyone in that car, killed.

episodes.title: Lucky Shot
episodes.description: When a freelance nightcrawler videographer turns up dead, NCIS discovers he secretly recorded evidence linked to a deadly cover-up, sending the team down a dangerous path toward a conspiracy that reaches far beyond a routine homicide investigation.

episodes.title: The Chair
episodes.description: After a U.S. operative is taken hostage, Director DiNozzo goes back through the case file, questioning whether he made the right call, but the case isn't quite as closed as it looks.

episodes.title: Identity
episodes.description: Newly located in a Los Angeles mission, the NCIS Office of Special Projects welcomes Callen back to the team and races to solve a kidnapping case.

episodes.title: The Only Easy Day
episodes.description: A case involving the murder of a drug dealer turns personal for Special Agent Sam Hanna when he discovers his former Navy Seal comrades are involved.

episodes.title: Predator
episodes.description: The team is assigned to track down a missing unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) after it is compromised during a training exercise killing a marine before it disappears.

episodes.title: Search and Destroy
episodes.description: The NCIS team searches Los Angeles for the lead suspect of a murdered Iraqi businessman, a former Marine who had been hired by a private security firm to protect him.

episodes.title: Killshot
episodes.description: When a United States citizen of North Korean descent is murdered, the secrets to classified software are thought to be lost until NCIS uncovers a suspect from Director Vance's past.

episodes.title: Keepin' It Real
episodes.description: The NCIS team must find a motive when they discover the body of a marine who had been living a double life as a wealthy bachelor.

episodes.title: Pushback
episodes.description: Following the murder of a Russian woman, the NCIS team uncovers evidence that answers who and why Callen was shot six months ago.

episodes.title: Ambush
episodes.description: While Hetty is attending a Senate hearing in D.C., the investigation of a murdered Marine Lance Corporal leads the NCIS team to stolen anti-tank missiles and a dangerous militia group.

episodes.title: Random on Purpose
episodes.description: Forensic scientist Abby Sciuto joins the Los Angeles NCIS team when a murder case resembles the pattern for a serial killer she has been tracking.

episodes.title: Brimstone
episodes.description: As the courtyard is being transformed with holiday decorations, the NCIS team races to solve the murder of a Marine by an exploding cell phone and to find the remaining men of his former EOD unit before another deadly explosion kills someone else.

episodes.title: Breach
episodes.description: The death of a Petty Officer leads the NCIS team to a teenager in Sam's life. Meanwhile, Hetty is concerned about the effect that the workload is having on the team.

episodes.title: Past Lives
episodes.description: The murder of a recently released convict forces Callen to go undercover solo as an old alias, while Sam and the LA team track him from a distance.

episodes.title: Missing
episodes.description: The team rushes to a crime scene after receiving an "agent needs assistance" page and learns that one of their own is in peril.

episodes.title: LD50
episodes.description: A crime scene poses a national security risk when the LA team discovers the location was used to create a deadly toxin which is now missing.

episodes.title: The Bank Job
episodes.description: While opening a safety deposit box at a local bank, NCIS Special Agent Kensi Blye is shot after three armed assailants enter and hold everyone in the building hostage.

episodes.title: Chinatown
episodes.description: The death of a lieutenant commander appears to be suicide but the NCIS team uncovers evidence corresponding to murder. Also, Operational Psychologist Nate Getz joins Special Agent Kensi Blye in the field.

episodes.title: Full Throttle
episodes.description: After a sailor is killed during an underground street race, the NCIS team determines that his car had been sabotaged and contained confidential Navy equipment. Meanwhile, Callen is forced to take traffic school.

episodes.title: Blood Brothers
episodes.description: The investigation of a drive-by shooting has the NCIS team searching Los Angeles for the dead marine's younger brother who may be the next target and the one with the answers.

episodes.title: Hand-to-Hand
episodes.description: When an undercover operation has the NCIS team investigating a MMA gym and its fighters, Sam Hanna is tasked with donning gloves and entering the cage for a one-on-one fight.

episodes.title: Fame
episodes.description: NCIS investigates the murder of a Navy officer entangled in the world of Hollywood glitz and glamour as the team is joined at Hetty's request by LAPD liaison Marty Deeks.

episodes.title: Found
episodes.description: The NCIS team races to save one of their own when they receive video evidence of Special Agent Dominic Vail being held hostage months after he was kidnapped.

episodes.title: Hunted
episodes.description: The NCIS team is on the hunt for a terrorist who escaped Army custody during a secretive transfer in Los Angeles.

episodes.title: Burned
episodes.description: After Callen's cover is blown and compromises the unit, the NCIS team races to find out who is behind the security breach.

episodes.title: Callen, G
episodes.description: Callen races against a ruthless adversary to locate a woman who knows the whereabouts of a forgotten fortune earmarked to fund a new war in the Middle East - and also holds the tantalizing key to his unknown past.

episodes.title: Human Traffic
episodes.description: When one of their own disappears while undercover, the team must work alongside LAPD on a case involving human-trafficking, money laundering and drugs.

episodes.title: Black Widow
episodes.description: After a mysterious hit squad takes out a Special Agent on assignment, the NCIS team jumps into action before the next target is set.

episodes.title: Borderline
episodes.description: The NCIS team jumps into action when video surveillance footage shows an ambush on a humvee transporting Marines in the desert. Meanwhile, Nate returns from his mystery assignment.

episodes.title: Special Delivery
episodes.description: The NCIS team investigates the murder of a Marine with top-level security clearance after he is found dead and missing a hand in a Beverly Hills parking lot off Rodeo Drive.

episodes.title: Little Angels
episodes.description: Videotape revealing a Naval Commander's daughter being buried alive strikes a nerve with Special Agent Sam Hanna and thrusts the NCIS team in a race against the clock to save the girl before time runs out.

episodes.title: Standoff
episodes.description: After a downtown Navy Recruitment Center is held hostage, Callen mediates with his ex-partner, Tracy Keller, to uncover information about a hijacked shipment of Spike missiles.

episodes.title: Anonymous
episodes.description: After a state department employee and a plastic surgeon are murdered by a group of terrorists, the NCIS team must frantically search for the only witness who can identify the killers' surgically altered faces.

episodes.title: Bounty
episodes.description: When a former Army Sergeant responsible for hunting down high-value targets is found dead, the NCIS team searches for terrorist leaders suspected of his murder. Meanwhile, Deeks bonds with a person of interest in the case, making him more determined than ever to track down the killers.

episodes.title: Absolution
episodes.description: Murdered antiques dealer has Hetty and the NCIS team searching for his missing book containing top-secret information in part one of a two-part episode.

episodes.title: Deliverance
episodes.description: Hetty and the NCIS team continue to search for an elusive book that has the attention of several foreign security agencies, in the conclusion of a two-part episode.

episodes.title: Disorder
episodes.description: Kensi connects personally with a discharged Navy Intelligence officer suffering from post traumatic stress disorder who is the sole survivor of a deadly dispute being investigated by the NCIS team.

episodes.title: Overwatch
episodes.description: The NCIS team uncovers an experimental Navy tracking system when a body containing a top-secret residue is stolen from an autopsy room. Meanwhile, Callen challenges Hetty on the rock wall.

episodes.title: Archangel
episodes.description: The NCIS team sets out to find the individual responsible for stealing a classified Pentagon document before the file's decryption code is cracked by the wrong party.

episodes.title: Lockup
episodes.description: Sam goes undercover as a prisoner to track down a terrorist group responsible for several bombings around the world.

episodes.title: Tin Soldiers
episodes.description: After Callen catches a man breaking into his house, a former KGB operative leads the NCIS team to a shipment of counterfeit computer chips entering the United States.

episodes.title: Empty Quiver
episodes.description: Suspicious of an undercover venture involving a deal between corrupt cops and military personnel, Callen and Sam try to expose the illegal operation by posing as California highway patrol officers.

episodes.title: Personal
episodes.description: Deeks' morning routine is disrupted when he is shot during a convenience store robbery, leaving the NCIS team to investigate whether he was the assailants' intended target.

episodes.title: Harm's Way
episodes.description: Sam resumes a former alias and boards a one-way flight to Yemen in hopes of tracking down a terrorist group's leader and rescuing the hostage son of a Saudi Prince.

episodes.title: Enemy Within
episodes.description: NCIS investigates whether the life of a Venezuelan politician is in danger after a Navy Intelligence Commander who is responsible for tracking his moves suddenly disappears.

episodes.title: The Job
episodes.description: Kensi goes undercover as a thief in the hopes of uncovering the object that a world-class thief intended to steal.

episodes.title: Rocket Man
episodes.description: After a rocket engine expert is killed, NCIS tech operator Eric Beale goes undercover for the first time to ensure that the classified technology used to build satellites is safe.

episodes.title: Plan B
episodes.description: Deeks resumes an old alias he is not fond of in order to protect his best friend and chief informant from a criminal group that wants him dead.

episodes.title: Imposters
episodes.description: After a Navy SEAL imposter is set ablaze, NCIS obtains new information regarding the whereabouts of the stolen Brachytherapy canister from a previous case that could be used to make a deadly bomb.

episodes.title: Familia
episodes.description: Hetty's sudden resignation prompts Callen and the NCIS team to investigate the reason why she would disappear in the hopes of tracking her down.

episodes.title: Lange, H.
episodes.description: The Special Projects team travels to Romania to search for Hetty, while delving into the history of the Comescu crime family, and their connection to Callen. Meanwhile, Eric and Nell discover that Lauren Hunter, the Office of Special Projects' Operations Manager, is a member of the Comescus.

episodes.title: Cyber Threat
episodes.description: The NCIS team joins forces with the NSA to find the creator and controller of a software program linked to a cyber attack against the Department of Defense. Meanwhile, Callen continues searching for more information about his past.

episodes.title: Backstopped
episodes.description: Special Agent Sam Hanna is sent undercover as a bomb specialist as the team races to locate stolen explosives somewhere in the city. Meanwhile, to much protest, Hunter changes the dynamics of the team and has Callen partnered with Kensi and Sam with Deeks.

episodes.title: Deadline
episodes.description: The NCIS team delves into the underground world of the Libyan resistance movement following the murder of a news reporter, and Hetty reveals details about Callen's past.

episodes.title: Sacrifice
episodes.description: The LAPD calls upon the NCIS team when a raid links a Mexican drug cartel to a wanted terrorist. Meanwhile, Sam's most prized possession is stolen.

episodes.title: Lone Wolf
episodes.description: The NCIS team investigates the murder of a former Navy intelligence officer who had been living a double life and traveling overseas on false passports.

episodes.title: Honor
episodes.description: The NCIS team must determine whether a dishonorably discharged Marine is the target of an international set-up or if he committed murder.

episodes.title: Greed
episodes.description: When a Navy ID is found on a dead body tied to a hazardous material smuggling case, NCIS is granted permission to investigate in Mexico and asked to help locate the missing materials.

episodes.title: Betrayal
episodes.description: After Sam's undercover mission in Sudan turns deadly, Callen and the NCIS team must track down their missing agent before it is too late.

episodes.title: The Debt
episodes.description: A botched assignment forces Hetty to fire Deeks and send him back to the LAPD. Meanwhile, an awkward goodbye between Kensi and Deeks leaves her with unexpected emotions for her old partner

episodes.title: Higher Power
episodes.description: The NCIS team must locate a classified device with the power to destroy Los Angeles that was stolen from a college research facility. Meanwhile, Sam tries to track down a highly sought-after Christmas present for his daughter, and Eric meets Nell's parents.

episodes.title: The Watchers
episodes.description: When a researcher with the Department of Defense is found dead, Nell must put her high IQ to the test when she goes undercover as his replacement. Meanwhile, Hetty's ability to lead the team is questioned by the new NCIS Assistant Director, Owen Granger.

episodes.title: Exit Strategy
episodes.description: When a vehicle transporting Jada Khaled is ambushed, NCIS must track down the culprit to save her and their case. Meanwhile, Sam is forced to confront Jada for the first time since returning from Sudan.

episodes.title: Partners
episodes.description: After a diplomatic service van transporting an unknown package from the State Department is hijacked, the NCIS team must determine who committed the crime and what has gone missing. Meanwhile, Callen and Sam celebrate five years as partners, but face one of their biggest challenges when they go undercover for a case.

episodes.title: Crimeleon
episodes.description: With Assistant Director Granger critiquing every move, the NCIS team must track down a chameleon-like killer who has evaded law enforcement agents, including their very own Special Agent G. Callen, across several countries.

episodes.title: Blye, K.
episodes.description: The NCIS: LA team searches for new evidence to prove Kensi Blye's innocence after she is taken into custody as the lead suspect in a murder investigation involving her deceased father's sniper unit.

episodes.title: Blye, K., Part 2
episodes.description: The NCIS: LA team continues to search for new evidence to prove Kensi Blye's innocence after a private meeting involving her deceased father's sniper unit turns deadly.

episodes.title: The Dragon and the Fairy
episodes.description: The NCIS: LA team investigates a shooting outside the Vietnamese Consulate just prior to an international conference at the venue that the Secretary of the Navy is scheduled to attend.

episodes.title: Vengeance
episodes.description: When the body of a Navy Intel Officer is found, evidence points to a team of Navy SEALs who are about to depart on a hostage rescue mission, leaving former Navy SEAL Sam Hanna to interrogate the group and possibly compromise the mission.

episodes.title: Patriot Acts
episodes.description: When a former Marine is suspected of creating a chemical bomb, the NCIS: LA team joins the FBI's domestic terrorist task force including Operational Psychologist Nate Getz.

episodes.title: Touch of Death
episodes.description:
The joint NCIS: Los Angeles and Hawaii Five-0 task force travel from Hawaii to Los Angeles, when the lead suspect in the case moves to the mainland with a deadly virus in tow. 

The crossover started on Hawaii Five-0 S02E21.

episodes.title: Neighborhood Watch
episodes.description: Kensi and Deeks are sent undercover as married couple Melissa and Justin when evidence points to a Russian sleeper cell in a suburban neighborhood.

episodes.title: Sans Voir
episodes.description: Callen and the NCIS: LA team confront their vengeful adversary, the Chameleon, when an undercover case ignites a deadly mind game orchestrated by the criminal mastermind.

episodes.title: Sans Voir, Part 2
episodes.description: Callen and the NCIS: LA team confront their vengeful adversary, the Chameleon, when an undercover case ignites a deadly mind game orchestrated by the criminal mastermind.

episodes.title: Endgame
episodes.description: Following Callen's public shooting of the Chameleon on last season's finale cliffhanger, all is not well with the NCIS: LA team, as Callen is placed on suspension and Hetty adjusts to retired life.

episodes.title: Recruit
episodes.description: A drone strike on a bomb-making compound in Afghanistan reveals the body of a recently retired Marine, leaving the NCIS: LA team to investigate why the Marine returned to Afghanistan and whether or not he betrayed the country he fought for.

episodes.title: The Fifth Man
episodes.description: The NCIS: LA team investigate a compromised intel operation after four people connected to the classified project are killed at a diner explosion. As Deeks and Kensi are on the trail of those involved, they learn that a wayward teenage girl might be related and Kensi can't help but be empathetic to her situation.

episodes.title: Dead Body Politic
episodes.description: The NCIS: LA team investigates the tragic death of a U.S. senatorial candidate's staffer who is run over crossing the street. The high-profile case becomes a matter of national security as the agents must determine whether it is an isolated tragic incident or a politically connected plot that might put others in danger.

episodes.title: Out of the Past
episodes.description: When a CIA agent who worked with Sam Hanna over eight years ago seeks his help and is soon found dead of an apparent suicide, Hanna and Callen suspect foul play and a bigger conspiracy. Meanwhile, Deeks finds his inner "dog whisperer" with Kensi as the two go undercover and enter a dog show with a prized poodle.

episodes.title: Rude Awakenings
episodes.description: The NCIS: LA team continues their investigation behind the death of a CIA agent that leads to a dangerous ring of Russian super agents. In a race against time, Hanna risks having a secret exposed.

episodes.title: Skin Deep
episodes.description: The NCIS: LA team heads to the beach to question the possible link between a surfer, an Internet video and a dead Naval tech scientist. Meanwhile, as Callen and Hanna investigate the victim's intelligence connections, Deeks and Kensi go undercover to catch their suspects and some waves.

episodes.title: Collateral
episodes.description: The NCIS: LA team questions the motive behind the murder of a retired CIA agent turned millionaire and in the process also questions what Hetty knows about the case.

episodes.title: The Gold Standard
episodes.description: The NCIS: Los Angeles team investigates the strange and brazen heist executed by gunmen in costumes that could directly impact the U.S. economy. Meanwhile, as Deeks testifies on a case, Granger insists on partnering up with a very reluctant Kensi.

episodes.title: Free Ride
episodes.description: Callen, Sam, Kensi and Deeks spend Christmas aboard an aircraft carrier investigating the death of a fellow NCIS special agent.  Meanwhile, Nell and Eric make the most of the holidays back at headquarters and Hetty takes a trip.

episodes.title: Drive
episodes.description: A former defendant of Deeks is targeted for discovering information that could dismantle a lucrative car shipping operation with links to a global terrorist ring. Meanwhile, the NCIS: LA team tackles the large-scale stolen car operation from the inside when Kensi goes undercover in an auto body shop.

episodes.title: Paper Soldiers
episodes.description: A distraught widow is suspicious of the circumstances surrounding her Marine husband’s last battle and Sam and Callen help to determine if there has been a cover-up. Meanwhile, Hetty summons Operational Psychologist Nate Getz to be her “pawn” and the rest of the NCIS: LA sense another evaluation on the horizon.

episodes.title: The Chosen One
episodes.description: Callen goes undercover to infiltrate a network of Chechen terrorists who are recruiting foreign fighters to join their cause and planning their next attack in the U.S..

episodes.title: Kill House
episodes.description: Callen, Sam, Kensi and Deeks go undercover as an elite tactical force in order to investigate an ambush tied to a cartel kingpin with terrorist connections.

episodes.title: History
episodes.description: An NCIS: LA investigation leads the team to question a lone survivor of a former terrorist organization, while Kensi and Deeks follow the trail into the woods.

episodes.title: Lokhay
episodes.description: Callen is concerned that Sam might be too invested after he takes on a missing persons case for an Afghani elder who helped him years ago when he was wounded on a mission.

episodes.title: Wanted
episodes.description: Sam fears for his family's safety when his wife is called to resume a former CIA cover after a case suggests ties to the infamous Sidorov and his stolen nukes.

episodes.title: Red
episodes.description: Callen and Sam fly to Idaho and join forces with NCIS: Red, a mobile team of agents who live together and investigate crimes in various locations, when a murder weapon found there matches one used in a national security case in Los Angeles.

episodes.title: Red-2
episodes.description: While the LA team chases leads digitally and locally, the NCIS: Red team travels in their mobile trucks, nicknamed "Laverne and Shirley," in a race to track down a cunning terrorist before he disappears.

episodes.title: Purity
episodes.description: When cyanide in a communal water jug lethally poisons a lieutenant and leaves a Navy pilot in serious condition, the NCIS: LA team investigates whether this is an isolated incident or an early test for large-scale water contamination.

episodes.title: Resurrection
episodes.description: A body is stolen after a special task force successfully takes down an infamous cartel boss, leaving the NCIS: LA team to investigate the leak and track down the missing body.

episodes.title: Raven & The Swans
episodes.description: Callen questions Hetty's motivations when a bizarre case involving a mysterious woman is revealed to be an undercover agent from her past.

episodes.title: Parley
episodes.description: Deeks goes undercover to obtain information about an infamous arms dealer looking to get back in the business, but the woman he befriends leads the operation in a dangerous directon. Meanwhile, Kensi confronts new emotions as she runs surveillance on Deeks and his female source.

episodes.title: Descent
episodes.description: A nuclear explosion in the Pacific reignites the search for stolen nuclear weapons and prompts Hetty to shuffle the NCIS: LA partnerships, sending Callen and Kensi overseas and leaving Sam and Deeks teamed up state side.

episodes.title: Ascension
episodes.description: While Sam and Deeks recover from traumatic torture that will have a lasting impact on their personal and professional relationships, lives are still in jeopardy as the NCIS: LA team searches for stolen nuclear weapons.

episodes.title: Impact
episodes.description: In an effort to help Sam and Deeks return to work, Hetty calls upon Operational Psychologist Nate Getz to help them cope with their traumatic experience. Meanwhile, the rest of the NCIS: LA team investigates the murder of a former Navy Admiral and a controversial journalist aboard a private jet.

episodes.title: Omni
episodes.description: The NCIS: LA team must find who compromised a classified vaccine project from a bio tech company. Meanwhile, Deeks struggles with his emotions upon returning to the field.

episodes.title: Reznikov, N.
episodes.description: The NCIS: LA team finds themselves in danger while investigating a kidnapping case of a man claiming to be Callen's father.

episodes.title: Unwritten Rule
episodes.description: Analyst Nell Jones joins the NCIS: LA team in the field when a former Navy officer's girlfriend is kidnapped in exchange for Navy intelligence. Meanwhile, Deeks unknowingly breaks one of Hetty's rules.

episodes.title: Big Brother
episodes.description: Callen goes undercover at a prestigious high school after a 15-year-old hacker compromises terrorist missions.

episodes.title: The Livelong Day
episodes.description: The NCIS: LA team must notify Homeland Security when a murder investigation exposes a larger threat to a Los Angeles-based train.

episodes.title: Fallout
episodes.description: When an antiterrorism device is stolen, the team must quickly find the suspect and the device before an attack is made against Los Angeles. Meanwhile, Hetty realizes the case is bringing her back to someone from her past.

episodes.title: Recovery
episodes.description: Kensi goes undercover as a nutritionist and Deeks poses as a new patient at a rehab center to investigate the death of a Navy officer.

episodes.title: The Frozen Lake
episodes.description: Callen and Sam enlist the help of a Gurkha, an elite Nepali soldier specializing in knife fighting, to retrieve a missing thumb drive.  Meanwhile, Kensi and Deeks struggle to find a balance in their partnership.

episodes.title: Iron Curtain Rising
episodes.description: When a former Romanian Communist leader and suspected war criminal is discovered to be living in Los Angeles under a false identity, the NCIS: LA team must locate him before he disappears again.

episodes.title: Merry Evasion
episodes.description: A senator’s daughter is the victim of a home invasion. The team investigate to determine if it was a random crime or a targeted attack due to her father’s crackdown on international cyber warfare. Meanwhile, Kensi’s holiday spirit changes after she receives a surprise Christmas gift.

episodes.title: Allegiance
episodes.description: While in Afghanistan, Kensi and Granger join the team on a joint case when a federal agent in Los Angeles tied to Hawala, an ancient system of money transfer, is murdered.

episodes.title: War Cries
episodes.description: When two private military contractors are murdered, the teams' investigation leads to a suspect who puts one of their own in serious danger. Meanwhile, Sam sets up Callen on a blind date.

episodes.title: Tuhon
episodes.description: Sam and Callen head to Mexico to search for Tuhon, a retired assassin they encountered on their very first case together, now a suspect in the murder of a diplomat. Meanwhile, Nate and Deeks stay in Los Angeles to assist with the investigation.

episodes.title: Fish Out of Water
episodes.description: Following an explosion at a fish market, the NCIS: LA team partners with an undercover DEA agent to determine if the incident is an act of terrorism or a botched drug smuggling deal. Meanwhile, in Afghanistan, Granger and Kensi investigate a helicopter crash that could be tied to their ongoing search for the infamous white ghost.

episodes.title: Between the Lines
episodes.description: When an undercover agent is identified and executed by a local gang, the NCIS: Los Angeles team must locate the mole before other agents' lives are put in danger. Meanwhile, Granger begins to worry when Kensi disappears in Afghanistan.

episodes.title: Zero Days
episodes.description: The NCIS: LA team is called in to determine if the computer system that controls Russian missiles is at risk after Eric overhears his friend, a computer systems expert, being attacked during online game play. Meanwhile, Kensi is shocked when a familiar face from her past shows up in Afghanistan.

episodes.title: Spoils of War
episodes.description: After learning that Special Agent Kensi Blye disappeared and the Taliban may be he holding her captive, Hetty sends the NCIS: LA team to Afghanistan on a rescue mission.

episodes.title: Windfall
episodes.description: When the NCIS: Los Angeles team investigates a case involving a former marine who is being tracked down by members of al Qaeda for embezzling money from Iraq, Hetty assigns Nell to join Deeks in the field. Meanwhile, Eric is given a new partner in Ops.

episodes.title: Three Hearts
episodes.description: When an undercover NCIS agent is suspected of working for the smuggler he's supposed to be investigating, the team takes him into custody to find his true intentions. Meanwhile, Kensi and Deeks discuss their personal relationship as Kensi returns to the field.

episodes.title: One More Chance
episodes.description: Sam is convinced that the theft of software for a new unmanned aerial vehicle is connected with the disappearance of the lead engineer's 10-year-old daughter, a girl Sam once provided protection detail for in Saudi Arabia.

episodes.title: Exposure
episodes.description: When a news reporter announces the group responsible for the deadly explosion at a military-sponsored charity event, the team must investigate her claims and search for the attacker.

episodes.title: Deep Trouble
episodes.description: When the NCIS: LA team and the DEA uncover the cartel's plans to slyly transport billions of dollars' worth of cocaine from Colombia to the United States using a submarine, Callen and Sam must quickly locate the missing vessel. Meanwhile, Hetty is called to Washington in the aftermath of the controversial mission in Afghanistan.

episodes.title: Deep Trouble, Pt. II
episodes.description: Callen and Sam are trapped in an armed submarine that terrorists have aimed to hit an aircraft carrier in San Diego. Meanwhile, Hetty defies orders and forgoes her trip to Washington, as the team tries to locate and save Callen and Sam and prevent the terrorist attack.

episodes.title: Inelegant Heart
episodes.description: The NCIS: LA team discovers that one of their own is compromised when they investigate the murder of a Navy contractor involved in illegal transactions of confidential data. Meanwhile, Hetty is under investigation in Washington, D.C., when the Department of Justice arrives in L.A. to investigate the team.

episodes.title: Praesidium
episodes.description: The NCIS: LA team takes action to protect one of their own while being interrogated by the Department of Justice. Meanwhile, Nell goes undercover as Hetty, and Director Leon Vance gives Hetty disturbing news while she is in Washington.

episodes.title: The 3rd Choir
episodes.description: When the NCIS: LA team learns that someone from their past is targeting one of their own, they desperately search the city. Meanwhile, Operational Psychologist Nate Getz visits Nell to help her through her traumatic experience.

episodes.title: Black Budget
episodes.description: Callen and Sam head to Mexico to track down the only employee who managed to escape a professional shooting at the Department of Defense. The rest of the team works to uncover the motive behind the shooting.

episodes.title: SEAL Hunter
episodes.description: When Sam is arrested for murdering a woman, Callen and Granger work to clear his name. Meanwhile, Kensi and Deeks discover a link between the victim and a student from Sam's past.

episodes.title: Leipei
episodes.description: When a man is murdered by a small drone, the team discovers his connection to a terrorist group that is planning another local attack. With time running short, Nell must use her drone expertise to try to divert a disaster in Long Beach.

episodes.title: The Grey Man
episodes.description: Kensi and Deeks go undercover to investigate the murder of a homeless man who was a former marine and CIA agent and discover his connection to the Mexican cartel.

episodes.title: Traitor
episodes.description: After Granger is poisoned by the mole and Eric is one of the seven suspects, Hetty orders a lockdown while everyone is investigated.

episodes.title: Reign Fall
episodes.description: Sam reflects on his own upbringing and relationship with his father when the team investigates the murders of marines who have sons in military academies.

episodes.title: Humbug
